plain.li: [theirs,s:open] {FROM} bids me tell you this, and in these words:
[theirs,s:open] I carry words from {FROM} of {TOWN}. I have kept them as they were given:
[theirs,s:open,warm|cordial] {FROM} sends word, and smiled while giving it:
[theirs,s:open,cool|curt|refusal] {FROM} gave me this to say, and no more:
[theirs,s:open,war] Under the white feather, I bring {FROM}'s words:
[theirs,s:open,w:tribal] Listen. These are {FROM}'s words, carried from the fire at {TOWN}:
[theirs,s:close] That is all {FROM} said, though it was said twice so I would not drop it on the road.
[theirs,s:close] Those are the words. I have carried them as well as I can.
[theirs,s:close,warm|cordial] {FROM} said to say it warmly, so imagine it so.
[theirs,s:close,cool|curt|refusal] That is all. {FROM} did not want more said.
[theirs,s:close,w:tribal] The words are given. Now they are yours to keep.
[ours,s:open] {FROM} of {COLONY} bids me tell you this:
[ours,s:open] I bring words from {COLONY}, from {FROM}, for {TO}:
[ours,s:open,w:tribal] Listen. These are {FROM}'s words, from the fire at {COLONY}:
[ours,s:close] Those are {FROM}'s words, as near as I could keep them.
[ours,s:close] That is the message. {FROM} said it twice, to be sure.
[theirs,olde,s:open] {FROM} biddeth me tell thee this, and in these words:
[theirs,olde,s:open] I bear words from {FROM} of {TOWN}, kept as they were given me:
[theirs,olde,s:open,cool|curt|refusal] {FROM} gave me this to say, and no more:
[theirs,olde,s:close] That is all {FROM} said, though it was said twice, lest I lose it upon the road.
[theirs,olde,s:close] Those be the words. I have borne them as well as I might.
[ours,olde,s:open] {FROM} of {COLONY} biddeth me tell thee this:
[ours,olde,s:close] Those be {FROM}'s words, as near as I could keep them.
